release_notes: Build 62 broadens Website Link Tracker recovery after Build 61 proved too dependent on expected settings.json locations.
Recovery now searches directly for factburst-link-tracker.json in the recorded development root, migration source, FactVaultManager app-data and recovery backups, plus common repository layouts.
Unexpected legacy runtime layouts such as hybrid/FactVaultManager.Desktop/data are now recoverable even when there is no matching settings.json file beside the tracker.
Recovered tracker keys are decrypted only for the current Windows user and are immediately re-encrypted into installed persistent storage; keys are never written to logs or recovery markers.
Existing installed tracker settings remain untouched, and both Build 61 and Build 62 recovery markers prevent a deliberately cleared configuration being resurrected later.
The Website settings shortcut continues to open Settings directly on Link Tracker if no recoverable local configuration exists.
